conditions.scope: Native client update/prelaunch; a copied server identity may have divergent journals. Older missing witnesses migrate only from validated known native client receipts and an exact content-addressed policy.

change.summary: Installed targets remain resolvable when a remote journal replaces a locally installed branch; another profile no longer retargets a remembered route.

modifiers.before: Active state persists only token and ledger; refresh replaces the only journal mirror, losing active generation metadata on a divergent server with the same pack ID. Per-user connection origin is shared across profiles.
modifiers.after: Native commit stores the exact journal witness beside active token/ledger, checkpoints it before mirror replacement, pins policy/content, and resolves active state independently. Legacy missing metadata can be recovered read-only from a known native instance with identical token and SHA1-verified policy. Login saves an instance-owned route; shared credentials/certificate trust remain unchanged.

cause.owner: Mods/JEMBootstrap pinned native AutoModpack source patch

rationale.purpose: Finish native updates without repeated attempts or manually editing installed caches, pointers, JAR projections or trust settings.
rationale.decision_source: User supplied the exact missing61920a3 journal-entry failure after updating JustEnoughMods, asked what friends should do, and confirmed client closure. Native checkpoint/validated peer migration/instance route chosen by Codex from actual local49/remote6 journals and shared origin evidence.

introduced.summary: Keep committed generation metadata independent of fetched journal branches and bind saved routes to the instance.

history.summary: Keep committed generation metadata independent of fetched journal branches and bind saved routes to the instance.

systems: Native update planning and helper recovery
relations: Commit -> persisted generation witness -> refresh preserves installed metadata -> native planner compares installed/advertised targets without fabricating history
notes: No world, registry, network schema, remote generation or MineRENT change. No runtime tests or game launch.
No assumed user consent for new code; native JAR review and certificate pinning remain unchanged. Peer journals supply metadata only, never credentials, ledgers or executable file bytes.
Client/bootstrap compatibility revision changes from jem.7 to jem.8 at the same native5.0.0-rc.1 wire/version contract.
unresolved: Manual user acceptance and completed native migration after installing bootstrap remain pending.
A generation with no valid local witness or verified policy still fails explicitly; no target/policy is invented.
